name: change-story-hashes-before-merge-steps
goal: A change story's `checks.state` is `recorded` only when the last gate run used the same commit and command list (`spec_hash`). Today the story's list has task acceptance and project gate commands but not the workflow's before-merge command steps the gate also ran, so a gate that just passed reads `stale`. Add those steps, exactly as the gate runs them, to the story's commands and hash.
